open_findings.title: Typed value comparison still borrows class/currency from unrelated text

reproductions.expected: literal_match for value 1000; an explicit amount unit must not be reclassified by another growth-ratio token in the claim body.
No CNY equivalence without candidate-bound currency/FX; another number's CNY token cannot support the USD number. Ambiguous association must stay unknown/partial, not full equivalence.
reproductions.variants: claim CNY/candidate USD; claim HKD/candidate CNY; claim USD/candidate HKD all fail

open_findings.root_cause: The value owner still flattens typed scope before comparing: an explicit scale-1 amount unit is confused with absent unit and falls back to all claim text; candidate currency is inferred from the entire support paragraph instead of the matching numeric candidate. The ratio and currency checks added in rework are therefore not attached to the same typed value.
required_fix: Distinguish declared unit with identity scale from missing/unknown unit. If explicit unit identifies an amount, do not derive its class or scale from other quantities/ratios in claim text.

Bind source value/scale/currency at one explicit local candidate scope; when correspondence is ambiguous retain unknown/partial. Do not borrow another amount's currency across a paragraph. A mixed-currency fragment may conservatively be unresolved rather than adding a large vocabulary.

Reuse existing numeric owner for explicit typed compatibility where applicable; lack of a particular function call alone is not the blocker. Do not create another unit table, approval gate or company-specific branches.

Add these parameterized cases alongside prior seven controls, bounded W20/numeric regressions and one offline CLI chain; then genuine independent re-review and final handoff SHA binding. No repeated full-repository suite is required.
